title: Maareecha further advises Ravana
introduction: Maareecha further advises Ravana to avoid confrontation with Rama for it would be ruinous to the entire demonic race. He narrates another episode of his misadventure with Rama and how he escaped from the all-pursuant arrow of Rama.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे एकोन चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 39th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् अस्मि तदा मुक्तः कथंचित् तेन संयुगे |
इदानीम् अपि यत् वृत्तम् तत् शृउणुष्व यत् उत्तरम्
verses.iast:
evam asmi tadā muktaḥ kathañcit tena saṃyuge |
idānīm api yat vṛttam tat śṛuṇuṣva yat uttaram
verses.translation: "Thus I was somehow released by him in a confrontation then in his teens. Now you may also listen to what has happened later in his adulthood." Thus Maareecha continued his advise to Ravana.

glosses.meaning: somehow, this way, released, I am

verses.devanagari:
राक्षाभ्याम् अहम् द्वाभ्याम् अनिर्विण्णः तथा कृतः |
सहितो मृग रूपाभ्याम् प्रविष्टो दँडका वने
verses.iast:
rākśābhyām aham dvābhyām anirviṇṇaḥ tathā kṛtaḥ |
sahito mṛga rūpābhyām praviṣṭo da.ṇḍakā vane
verses.translation: "Though Rama hit me previously in such a way, I unabashedly entered Dandaka forest together with two more demons who were in the guise of animals.

glosses.meaning: in such a way, rendered - previously hit in to ocean by Rama

verses.devanagari:
दीप्त जिह्वो महादंष्ट्रः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो महाबलः |
व्यचरन् दँडाकारण्यम् मांस भक्षो महामृगः
verses.iast:
dīpta jihvo mahādaṃṣṭraḥ tīkśṇa śṛṃgo mahābalaḥ |
vyacaran da.ṇḍākāraṇyam māṃsa bhakśo mahāmṛgaḥ
verses.translation: "On becoming a gigantic carnivorous animal with a torching tongue, incisive teeth and excruciating horns, and with an extraordinary energy, I was on the rove in Dandaka forest while getting at Rama.

glosses.meaning: while I was on the rove - from here the expressions at the end of verses, 3, 4, 5, 6, are eka anvaya - have a concatenation with - raamaam aasaadayan - I reached Rama - in the 7th verse.

verses.devanagari:
अग्निहोत्रेषु तीर्थेषु चैत्य वृक्षेषु रावण |
अत्यन्त घोरो व्यचरन् तापसान् संप्रधर्षयन्
verses.iast:
agnihotreṣu tīrtheṣu caitya vṛkśeṣu rāvaṇa |
atyanta ghoro vyacaran tāpasān sampradharṣayan
verses.translation: "I moved about Dandaka forest, oh, Ravana, in an extremely horrible aspect of animal, utterly brutalising the sages at ritual-altars, holy bathing places and under the trees of religious sanctuaries while reaching Rama.

glosses.meaning: at ritual-altars, holy bathing places, sanctuaries, trees of

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य दँडकारण्ये तापसान् धर्मचरिणः |
रुधिराणि पिबन्तः तेषाम् तन् मांसानि च भक्षयन्
verses.iast:
nihatya da.ṇḍakāraṇye tāpasān dharmacariṇaḥ |
rudhirāṇi pibantaḥ teṣām tan māṃsāni ca bhakśayan
verses.translation: "I have proceeded to Rama killing saints in Dandaka forest who are the treaders in saintliness, and drinking off their blood and feasting on their flesh.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषि माअंस अशनः क्रूरः त्रासयन् वनगोचरान् |
तदा रुधिर मत्तो अहम् व्यचरन् दँडका वनम्
verses.iast:
ṛṣi māaṃsa aśanaḥ krūraḥ trāsayan vanagocarān |
tadā rudhira matto aham vyacaran da.ṇḍakā vanam
verses.translation: "On becoming such a brutal animal I have been eating the flesh of sages, frightening the forest dwellers, and in that way I rambled in Dandaka forest besotted with blood-drinking while reaching Rama.

glosses.meaning: in that way, by blood, besotted with

verses.label: 3.39.7, 8a
verses.devanagari:
तदा अहम् दँडकारण्ये विचरन् धर्म दूषकः |
आसादयम् तदा रामम् तापसम् धर्मम् आश्रितम्
वैदेहि च महाभागाम् लक्ष्मणम् च महरथम् |
verses.iast:
tadā aham da.ṇḍakāraṇye vicaran dharma dūṣakaḥ |
āsādayam tadā rāmam tāpasam dharmam āśritam
vaidehi ca mahābhāgām lakśmaṇam ca maharatham |
verses.translation: "While I was wandering in Dandaka forest as an abuser of virtue, then I reached Rama who by then has assumed the rectitude befitting to a saint, and I even reached the great-fortunate Vaidehi and top-speeded-chariot-rider Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: righteousness - rectitude, who resorted to - assumed rectitude of sainthood

verses.label: 3.39.8b, 9, 10
verses.devanagari:
तापसम् नियत आहारम् सर्व बूत हिते रतम्
सः अहम् वन गतम् रामम् परिभूय महाबलम् |
तापसो अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा पूर्व वैरम् अनुस्मरन्
अभ्यधावम् सुसंक्रुद्धः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो मृग आकृतिः |
जिघांसुः अकृतप्रज्ञः तम् प्रहारम् अनुस्मरन्
verses.iast:
tāpasam niyata āhāram sarva būta hite ratam
saḥ aham vana gatam rāmam paribhūya mahābalam |
tāpaso ayam iti jñātvā pūrva vairam anusmaran
abhyadhāvam susaṅkruddhaḥ tīkśṇa śṛṃgo mṛga ākṛtiḥ |
jighāṃsuḥ akṛtaprajñaḥ tam prahāram anusmaran
verses.translation: "I was in the shape of an animal with incisive horns. Such as I was I recollected my earlier grudge against that great mighty Rama who takes delight in the welfare of all being, who by then was santlike on a regulated diet and abiding in the forest, whereby I presumed him to be mere hermit. In that way, I was very extremely infuriated to recollect his earlier assault on me, and I indiscriminately dashed towards him, only to kill him, completely disregarding his other faculties.

glosses.meaning: [I am in] animal, in the shape of
he is, [mere] hermit, on thinking - presuming
completely, disregarding - his other faculties once shown

verses.devanagari:
तेन त्यक्ताः त्रयो बाणाः शिताः शत्रु निबर्हणाः |
विकृष्य सुमहत् चापम् सुपर्ण अनिल तुल्य गाः
verses.iast:
tena tyaktāḥ trayo bāṇāḥ śitāḥ śatru nibarhaṇāḥ |
vikṛṣya sumahat cāpam suparṇa anila tulya gāḥ
verses.translation: "Stringing out his highly magnificent bow Rama then released three excruciating and enemy eliminating arrows which in their egress match the Air-god and the Divine-Eagle Garuda.

glosses.meaning: Divine Eagle Garuda, Air-god, matching, in egress

verses.devanagari:
ते बाणा वज्र संकाशाः सुघोरा रक्त भोजनाः |
आजग्मुः सहिताः सर्वे त्रयः संनतपर्वणः
verses.iast:
te bāṇā vajra saṅkāśāḥ sughorā rakta bhojanāḥ |
ājagmuḥ sahitāḥ sarve trayaḥ saṃnataparvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "All those three thunderbolt like arrows that have only blood for their board, acutely bent at barbs, and that are highly horrendous have come at us in a coordinated manner.

glosses.meaning: came - towards us, the three in animal guise.

verses.devanagari:
पराक्रमज्ञो रामस्य शठो दृष्ट भयः पुरा |
समुत्क्रांतः ततः मुक्तः तौ उभौ राक्षसौ हतौ
verses.iast:
parākramajño rāmasya śaṭho dṛṣṭa bhayaḥ purā |
samut.hkrāṃtaḥ tataḥ muktaḥ tau ubhau rākśasau hatau
verses.translation: "As I have earlier seen the fear caused by his arrow I am in the know of Rama's valour, hence I retreated from there trickily and gingerly, but the other two demons were killed.
notes: Here the action of Rama's arrow is indicated. Rama's arrow will not shoot at the back of the opponent or it backstabs either. Even when killing Vali, though Rama is not affronting Vali, Rama's arrow pierced Vali's chest. Here because Maareecha is retreating, that third arrow of Rama did not kill Maareecha but followed him in a chasing manner. But the other two demons unknowing about Rama's arrow, they confronted him and the other two arrows eliminated them. There is discussion on the word shaThaH 'one capable to trick' used in the verse as some mms employ the word sharaH, 'an arrow.' In this section vividly explainable verses are there in some ancient versions of mms. This particular verse reads like this in them: parākramajño rāmasya tathā dṛṣṭa bhayaḥ purā | āpatantam śaram dṛṣṭvā megha gaṃbhīra nissvanam || tato aham vegavān tatra vātaṃhā nimeśataḥ | apa krānta param pāram nivṛttaḥ sāgarāt śaraḥ || 'I am in the know of Rama's valour, and I am also in the know of what fear he caused in an earlier instance, and on seeing the arrows coming upon like thunderous clouds, in a wink I escaped to the other side of ocean, and Rama's arrow having come chasing me up to ocean-shore returned.' In here, the efficacy of Rama's arrow is clearly narrated and it is not clear why pundits did not consider these verses of ancient mms instead of the above verse.

glosses.meaning: though I can deceive him - warily

verses.devanagari:
शरेण मुक्तो रामस्य कथंचित् प्राप्यजीवितम् |
इह प्रव्राजितो युक्तः तापसो अहम् समाहितः
verses.iast:
śareṇa mukto rāmasya kathañcit prāpyajīvitam |
iha pravrājito yuktaḥ tāpaso aham samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: "When I was somehow exempted by the arrow of Rama I regained lifespan, and when that arrow made me to renounce everything like a monk and fled me to this place, the other side of ocean to where you came by your aircraft, here I am living here in a yogic way, self-collectedly like an ascetic.

glosses.meaning: sent as a monk on renouncing.

verses.devanagari:
वृक्षे वृक्षे हि पश्यामि चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरम् |
गृहीत धनुषम् रामम् पाश हस्तम् इव अंतकम्
verses.iast:
vṛkśe vṛkśe hi paśyāmi cīra kṛṣṇa ajina ambaram |
gṛhīta dhanuṣam rāmam pāśa hastam iva aṃtakam
verses.translation: "From then on wards, I am indeed descrying Rama at this tree and at that tree, dressed in jute-cloths and black deerskin, and handling his bow like the Terminator handling a tether.

glosses.meaning: tether, in hand, Terminator, as with
at tree, at tree, I behold, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
अपि राम सहस्राणि भीतः पश्यामि रावण |
राम भूतम् इदम् सर्वम् अरण्यम् प्रतिभाति मे
verses.iast:
api rāma sahasrāṇi bhītaḥ paśyāmi rāvaṇa |
rāma bhūtam idam sarvam araṇyam pratibhāti me
verses.translation: "Given to fright I even visualise thousands Rama-s, and whole this forest is reflecting to me as one entity of Rama.

glosses.meaning: with Rama's, entity, reflects, to me.

verses.devanagari:
रामम् एव हि पश्यामि रहिते राक्षसेश्वर |
दृष्ट्वा स्वप्न गतम् रामम् उद् भ्रमामि विचेतनः
verses.iast:
rāmam eva hi paśyāmi rahite rākśaseśvara |
dṛṣṭvā svapna gatam rāmam ud bhramāmi vicetanaḥ
verses.translation: "Even at a place void of people I am envisaging Rama alone, and oh, king of demons, even if he enters my dream, in fact, I am jolting up and swooning.

glosses.meaning: none is not there - void of people
dream, who entered, Rama, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
र कार अदीनि नामानि राम त्रस्तस्य रवण |
रत्नानि च रथाः च एव वित्रासम् जनयन्ति मे
verses.iast:
ra kāra adīni nāmāni rāma trastasya ravaṇa |
ratnāni ca rathāḥ ca eva vitrāsam janayanti me
verses.translation: "Oh, Ravana, appalled of Rama the names starting with the syllable 'ra' like ratna-s, ratha-s, viz., gemstones, chariots are appalling to me, including your name, that starts with a 'ra....'
notes: 'If I hear the first letter 'ra' of any given name, I am scared at the ensuing second syllable presuming it to be 'ma' and if that second syllable of that word I am going to hear happens to be other than 'ma' then my fear ceases.'

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तस्य प्रभावज्ञो न युद्धम् तेन ते क्षमम् |
बलिम् वा नमुचिं वा अपि हन्यद्धि रघुन्ंअंदन
verses.iast:
aham tasya prabhāvajño na yuddham tena te kśamam |
balim vā namuciṃ vā api hanyaddhi raghunṃaṃdana
verses.translation: "I am well-acquainted with his efficacy, and a war with him will be an unfair thing for you, for that Raghu's descendant can in fact kill either Emperor Bali or Namuchi, the demon.
notes: Emperor Bali is more powerful and mighty than Ravana.ānanda rāmāyana says in a chapter on the 'defeats of Ravana' rāvaṇa parājaya, that Ravana once entered netherworld to conquer it, where Bali is held captive by Trivikrama, i.e., Vishnu. At that time Bali and his queen are playing dice game. When Ravana entered, the dice in the hand of Bali has slipped to the floor, and Bali asks Ravana to pick and give it before conquering netherworld. Ravana who lifted Mt. Kailash could not lift that two-inch dice, which is so far handled playfully by Bali. Such is the might of Emperor Bali

glosses.meaning: I am, of his, efficacy, knower of
Emperor Bali, either, Namuchi, or, even

verses.devanagari:
रणे रामेण युद्ध्स्व क्षमाम् वा कुरु रावण |
न ते राम कथा कार्या यदि माम् द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि
verses.iast:
raṇe rāmeṇa yuddhsva kśamām vā kuru rāvaṇa |
na te rāma kathā kāryā yadi mām draṣṭum icchasi
verses.translation: "You may either wage a war with Rama if you wish to avenge the killings of Khara and others, or forgive and forget that Rama agreeing to my suggestions, but do not broach the topic of Rama with me if you wish to see me alive.

glosses.meaning: in war, with Rama, you may combat
forgive and forget, either, you do
, me, to see, you wish, if
by you, Rama's, episode [topic] not, to be done [be broached.]

verses.devanagari:
बहवः साधवो लोके युक्ता धर्मम् अनुष्टिताः |
परेषाम् अपराधेन विनष्टाः स परिच्छदाः
verses.iast:
bahavaḥ sādhavo loke yuktā dharmam anuṣṭitāḥ |
pareṣām aparādhena vinaṣṭāḥ sa paricchadāḥ
verses.translation: "In the world many of the sagacious and reasonable people that are the practisers of righteousness are utterly ruined along with their kith and kin, just by the misdeeds of others.

verses.devanagari:
सः अहम् पर अपराधेन विनाशेयम् निशाचर |
कुरु यत् ते क्षमम् तत् त्वम् अहम् त्वाम् न अनुयामि वै
verses.iast:
saḥ aham para aparādhena vināśeyam niśācara |
kuru yat te kśamam tat tvam aham tvām na anuyāmi vai
verses.translation: "Such a saintly one as I am, I am bound to ruin by other's misdeeds, hence you do whatever that is fair to you, but I am not the one to simply take after you.

glosses.meaning: by other's, misdeed, I bound to ruin

verses.devanagari:
रामः च हि महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः |
अपि राक्षस लोकस्य भवेत् अन्तकरो अपि हि
verses.iast:
rāmaḥ ca hi mahātejā mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ |
api rākśasa lokasya bhavet antakaro api hi
verses.translation: "Definitely Rama is the one with exceptional resplendence, exemplary courage and extraordinary power, and for sure, he becomes an eradicator of the world of demons.

verses.devanagari:
यदि शूर्पणखा हेतोः जनस्थान गत खरः |
अति वृत्तो हतः पूर्वम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा |
अत्र ब्रूहि यथावत् त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः
verses.iast:
yadi śūrpaṇakhā hetoḥ janasthāna gata kharaḥ |
ati vṛtto hataḥ pūrvam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā |
atra brūhi yathāvat tvam ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: "If Khara positioned in Janasthaana has firstly overstepped his bounds and attacked Rama, that too owing to Shuurpanakha, and if Rama of uncomplicated actions has eliminated Khara in self-defence, what really is the transgression of Rama in that matter, you tell of that in the final analysis.

glosses.meaning: by one who is of - uncomplicated, actions, by Rama
as it is - in final analysis

verses.devanagari:
इदम् वचो बन्धु हित अर्थिना मया
यथा उच्यमानम् यदि न अभिपत्स्यसे |
स बान्धवः त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितम् रणे
हतो अद्य रामेण शरैः जिह्मगैः
verses.iast:
idam vaco bandhu hita arthinā mayā
yathā ucyamānam yadi na abhipatsyase |
sa bāndhavaḥ tyakśyasi jīvitam raṇe
hato adya rāmeṇa śaraiḥ jihmagaiḥ
verses.translation: "I am saying this word of advise as I am ambitious of the wellbeing of my kinsmen through you, and if this is disagreeable to you, you will have to deliver up your life in a confrontation with Rama along with the lives of your kinsmen, perishing at the linearly accelerating arrows of Rama.

glosses.meaning: not, you are agreeable for it
in a confrontation, life, you will deliver up.
